notes.title: BLOKDODGE 1.0 Release!
notes.notes:
[h1]The newest indie title from HotFreshGames is upon us![/h1]

Blokdodge is a 2D physics based side scroller with addicting gameplay and intoxicating music. This simple yet difficult game is easy to pick up, but hard to master. Guide your block through procedurally generated levels. Buy power ups to help you progress. Master geometry and beat your friends high score!
